summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO prototype entered through MMORPG Tools' menu and character-creation flow. Its main place is the Lantern March continent, with a central Reach, three starting hamlets and distant frontier landmarks; procedural terrain and scene builders support world content while MMORPG Tools and world scripts own the RPG lifecycle and gameplay behaviors.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - title/menu entry place; MMORPG Tools starts character selection and travel here.
places/character-creation-land/ - character preview place with creation camera and lighting setup.

places/main/ - Lantern March continent across 50 cells: Lantern's Reach, Thornhollow, Cinderhold, Gullrest, Windmill Farm, Briarwild, Emberstone Quarry, Saltmere and Frostveil/Sunscar/Elderveil frontiers.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub, training yard and Gatekeeper Elric (gatekeeper-elric) using scripts/elric.js.
places/main/cells/x-6z1.scene, x7z-1.scene, x2z11.scene - Thornhollow, Cinderhold and Gullrest starting-hamlet sites; their region names correspond to scripts/lib/regions.js.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene and surrounding cells - Briarwild wolf den and timber-tagged oak gatherables; wolves and oaks use scripts/wolves.js and scripts/woodcutting.js.

places/main/cells/x-1z-30.scene, x0z-30.scene, x30z-1.scene and x-28z0.scene - Frostveil altar/hut, Sunscar gate-and-oasis encampment, and Elderveil ancient tree/root arch; frontier props use scripts/gen/frontier.js.

places/main/cells/x0z-13.scene through x0z-27.scene, x15z-3.scene through x27z-2.scene, and x-13z1.scene through x-25z0.scene - waystones spaced along Frostveil, Sunscar and Elderveil routes; main place setup is in places/main/config.yaml.
roots: world.config.yaml - defaults to main-menu-land; binds player/camera templates, arrival, MMORPG UI and nametag behaviors, player actions, and WoW orbit/steer/autorun/release inputs.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod.json - registers MMORPG menu, player, character-selection, interaction and gameplay/creation camera behaviors.
templates/player.js#player - native behavior chain: humanoid-locomotion.js, scripts/player.js, scripts/vanguard.js, scripts/quest-player.js.
templates/camera.js#camera - native camera template using scripts/camera.js and engine look orientation.
places/main/config.yaml - main spawn, gravity, terrain, vegetation scatter and look configuration; the other place configs set up menu/creation scenes.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries and panel renderers consumed by mod behaviors and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/quest-data.js and scripts/lib/data/quests.yml - quest API and Q002 definitions/tuning used by quest UI, quest-player, Elric and woodcutting behaviors.
scripts/lib/data/wolves.yml - Briar Wolf timings, stats and spawn rows consumed by scripts/wolves.js.
scripts/lib/regions.js - ordered region lookup used by terrain generation and region consumers; includes Thornhollow, Cinderhold and Gullrest and sea bounds from terrain-reach.js.
scripts/terrain-reach.js - procedural continent height/material and coast functions shared by main terrain and region classification.
scripts/gen/shape.js and gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js, windmill*.js and frontier.js - procedural geometry/builders reused by scene instances.

scripts/grass.js, flower.js, pebble.js and grass-look.js - terrain scatter geometry/material reused by place bindings; scripts/lib/wow-move.js and wow-camera-controls config/motion share WoW-style movement mapping.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onInput, update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - sit, onInput, update.
scripts/vanguard.js - onInput, endAction, land; scripts/training-dummy.js - onSpawn, update, settle, standUp.
scripts/wolves.js - update; scripts/gen/wolf.js - skeleton, geometry; scripts/gen/frontier.js - geometry, collider.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput, update; scripts/elric.js - onSpawn, updateSchedule, update; scripts/woodcutting.js - updateSchedule, onSpawn, update.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-hud.js - renderTargetDisplay, renderHUD; lib/ui-quest.js - quest dialogue, turn-in and tracker renderers.
scripts/terrain-reach.js - QUARRY, FOREST, CRYPT, FEN, BAY, COAST, coastD, heightAt, materialAt; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and core velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw, animation channels and seated locomotion.
scripts/camera.js and MMORPG camera behaviors - core camera rig pose/local-player hiding versus mod orbit and creation framing.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - active RPG character/roster state, persistence and lifecycle transitions.
scripts/vanguard.js - player action/cooldown/guard state; scripts/training-dummy.js - dummy hp, down and hit-reaction state.
scripts/wolves.js - den respawnAt and spawned wolf AI/death state; wolves.yml owns pack rows and tuning.
scripts/quest-player.js - player quest, tally, inventory, gold, xp and dialog/hint state; it also writes timber-oak logsLeft/depletedUntil.
scripts/elric.js - Elric greeting/facing state; scripts/woodcutting.js - oak fall/regrowth presentation, distinct from quest-player's depletion state.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → MMORPG menu/player/character-select/main-menu-mgr behaviors → character creation and transition to main.
Character creation confirm in character-select.js → race/class and character state, roster storage; scripts/db.js migrate is not connected to this path.
world.config.yaml player template → humanoid-locomotion.js then player.js then vanguard.js then quest-player.js; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
moveX/moveZ/jump plus orbit/steer/autoRun inputs → scripts/player.js onInput and wow-move.js room-local intent → update moves body with place gravity; modal state locks look/movement.
attack/castSlot2/castSlot3 → scripts/vanguard.js schedules strikes/guard from vanguard.yml → nearby live enemy state.hp and hit metadata/FX.
training-dummy.js observes state.lastHitAt → hit-reel/down reaction; scheduled settle/standUp restores hp using vanguard.yml.
places/main/cells/x-1z0.scene Briar Wolf den → scripts/wolves.js reads wolves.yml and creates scripts/gen/wolf.js entities → chase/bite/death/respawn.
world.config.yaml interact/quest actions → scripts/quest-player.js onInput; E finds quest NPC or timber target, while quest UI actions accept/close/turn in Q002.
quest-player talk/accept/complete → quest-data.js and quests.yml → player quest/tally/inventory/gold/xp state; _questSave signals MMORPG player.js persistence.
quest-player E chop → one log in inventory/tally and oak logsLeft/depletedUntil; woodcutting.js handles fall/regrowth presentation.
Main terrain bindings → terrain-reach.js height/material and scatter scripts; regions.js classifies position → HUD region banner, including Thornhollow/Cinderhold/Gullrest and distant regions.
scripts/lib/regions.js and ui-hud.js each name/classify settlements: keep their circular names/radii and priority order synchronized when regions change.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, stone-bridge.js, farm.js, windmill*.js and frontier.js - procedural scene geometry reused by instances, varied by kind, dimensions, seed and transforms.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter reused by place bindings, varied by density, scale and seed; grass-look supplies material separately.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/camera.js and camera-creation.js - paired gameplay orbit and preview camera modes with creation-phase guards.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ui-*.js - modular panel renderers composed by ui.js for HUD, menu, quest, inventory, map, character and settings.
scripts/vanguard.js and scripts/training-dummy.js with vanguard.yml - player melee discipline and target reaction shared across dummies, varied by ability and per-dummy state.
scripts/wolves.js with wolves.yml and gen/wolf.js - den manager runs the configured wolf pack through shared AI/combat behavior, varied by spawn row.

scripts/quest-player.js on the player template, scripts/elric.js on the Q002 giver and scripts/woodcutting.js on timber oaks - shared quest/gathering loop with per-player quest and per-tree depletion state.
probableOrphans: scripts/db.js - schema migration only; no world or mod code calls migrate.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - realm roster definitions have no code consumer.
scripts/lib/data/races.yml - starting-zone table has no consumer; character selection uses the separate mod lib/races.js registry.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/currency.js - copper formatting/conversion helpers have no imports or call sites.
migrationNotes: Keep movement intent and locomotion scratch in room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity and place config owns gravity.
templates/player.js runs humanoid-locomotion before player.js; gait samples prior-tick velocity; quest-player follows vanguard in the behavior chain.
Core scripts/camera.js uses engine look orientation and feetPosition + eyeHeight × effectiveScale.y; MMORPG orbit/creation cameras are distinct paths.
Vanguard/wolf tuning uses seconds, metres and hit points; vanguard hits target.state.hp while wolves bite the MMORPG player's state.health.
Quest objectives use accept-time tally baselines; completedQuests is written before Q002 rewards, and _questSave is the MMORPG persistence signal.

Keep terrain-reach.js coast bounds, regions.js ordered classification and ui-hud.js's separately mirrored region-name logic aligned; static frontier sites and waystones use terrain-relative positions.
